projects.title: Diffuse for Windows
projects.description: A native Windows 11 port of Diffuse Music Live Wallpaper featuring a WinUI 3 floating tray flyout, Direct3D 11 + DirectComposition fluid shaders, SMTC Now Playing sync, and WASAPI Live Beats.

projects.title: Nectarlink Services
projects.description: A privileged Android priv-app AIDL Binder service for custom ROMs providing screen mirroring, input injection, virtual displays, device/call audio streaming, and clipboard sync for NectarLink without ADB or root.

projects.title: Nectarlink Module
projects.description: A systemless root module for Magisk, KernelSU, and APatch/FolkPatch that deploys Nectarlink Services as a privileged system_ext app with SELinux UHID rules and automated CI release bundling.

projects.title: Material Explorer
projects.description: An Android APK explorer and file manager built with Material Design 3 principles for intuitive navigation, APK inspection, and dynamic theming.

projects.title: Bedrock
projects.description: A minimalist monochrome notes editor for Android with Markdown live preview, interactive checklists, SHA-256 local encryption, and offline sync.

projects.title: Snapseed for Web
projects.description: A zero-server client-side photo processing web app inspired by Snapseed, featuring tactile gesture tuning, histograms, and RAW-like filters.

projects.title: Mikrotik Manager
projects.description: An automated helper utility designed to manage DHCP & IP allocations, prevent IP conflicts, and query active subnets on Mikrotik routers.

projects.title: The Scape Network
projects.description: A digital social update log, creative archive channel, and interactive developer/design hub built around Telegram under the Scape Sandbox banner.

projects.title: Kairo's Old Bot
projects.description: A legacy open-source modular Telegram utility bot built for fast channel administrative workflows, automated triggers, and group utilities.
